title: The Domino Effect
coreMove: Find the first small action whose completion knocks the next necessary action into reach.
sourcePressure: Chapter 2 adds sequence to leverage: large outcomes grow through cumulative domino actions where one right move creates conditions for the next.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating success as a single heroic leap or a generic list of baby steps.

hook: A single choice changes the whole day
The real priority is hiding under the busy work
The Domino Effect as a generic focus opener
counterintuition: Focus is harder than it looks
tryThisNow: Set a timer and list priorities
Write down your one thing without a concrete context
examples: generic office worker choosing email or strategy

exampleSpecs.stakes: matching funds disappear unless inspection happens first
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she books the structural inspection before drafting the glossy donor packet because the report unlocks every later ask
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a cracked plaster balcony photographed under a contractor's flashlight

exampleSpecs.domain: harbor cleanup after a fuel spill
exampleSpecs.stakes: fines rise while crews argue about the full cleanup map
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he orders the first containment boom across the narrow inlet, making the skimmer route and crew staging obvious
exampleSpecs.firstImage: orange containment boom unspooling across black water at daybreak

exampleSpecs.stakes: certification exam feels too large to start
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she records one ten-minute medication-history drill, then uses the transcript errors to choose tomorrow's vocabulary work
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a phone recording waveform beside a printed medication list

exampleSpecs.stakes: planting season closes before permits are approved
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he gets one utility-marking request filed, which frees the block map, sponsor forms, and Saturday crew plan to move
exampleSpecs.firstImage: spray-painted utility flags lined along an empty curb strip

exampleSpecs.stakes: festival submission locks in five days
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she fixes one corrupted room-tone file first and reveals that three dialogue edits now snap into place
exampleSpecs.firstImage: headphones resting beside a waveform with one red missing-file warning

exampleSpecs.stakes: one mistake could send a child to the hospital
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the director realizes the label printer calibration had to fall first because every menu, tray card, and staff script depended on it
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a label strip with one allergen icon printed half off the edge

skillTargets: connect today's move to a longer chain
avoid jumping to the final outcome too early

tryThisNowSpec: Choose one goal and draw three boxes: first move, what it unlocks, and what becomes possible after that.
